read_first: active conflict/front when a route, supply state, occupation or formation assignment matters
exact custody record and destination custody site when a prisoner state changes
combat zoom registry only when aggregate combat reserves exact named actors
write_order: validate side, force, place and command authority
update bounded conflict/front or custody facts
conserve exact and aggregate personnel across capture, release and combat zoom boundaries
emit semantic event after authoritative state is staged
invariants: Conflict is strategic state, not a second force hierarchy.
Fronts reference formations and routes; they do not own manpower.
Named actors reserved from aggregate combat are excluded from anonymous casualty allocation until exact reconciliation.
Custody assigns already-captured bodies to a custodian and place without capturing them twice.
Only custody-capable places own mechanical prisoner capacity/security.
